# Base egress allowlist for the workstation sandbox (ADR-0002 / ADR-0010 layer 3).
#
# One host per line. Matching is by suffix: "github.com" also allows any
# subdomain (api.github.com, …) but not "evilgithub.com". A leading "*." or "."
# is ignored. Blank lines and "#" comments are skipped.
#
# Extend per deployment with $EGRESS_ALLOWLIST (comma/space/newline separated),
# which `3pa run` (ADR-0009) will populate from managed config — do not edit
# this file for a single project. The LLM gateway host is added automatically
# from $FABAGENT_BASE_URL.

# ── Source control ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
github.com
codeload.github.com
objects.githubusercontent.com
raw.githubusercontent.com

# ── Package registries ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
registry.npmjs.org
pypi.org
files.pythonhosted.org
